proposals.before: Now you campaign against the southern Yi, have Yelang come to court, reduce the Qiang and Bo, seize Zhuya, build cities and towns, penetrate deep into the Xiongnu, and burn their Dragon City—discussers praise it.
proposals.after: Now you campaign against the southern Yi, have Yelang come to court, reduce the Qiang and Bo, seize Huizhou, build cities and towns, penetrate deep into the Xiongnu, and burn their Dragon City—discussers praise it.
proposals.reason: The Chinese has 薉州, not 珠崖/Zhuya; the literal translation names the wrong place.

proposals.before: yiyin day sweated over the kitchen cauldrons, the Grand Duke Tai peddled from a butcher's block, Baili Xi sold himself into service, Ning Qi sang beside his ox—all to escape that plight.
proposals.after: Yi Yin sweated over the kitchen cauldrons, the Grand Duke Tai peddled from a butcher's block, Baili Xi sold himself into service, Ning Qi sang beside his ox—all to escape that plight.
proposals.reason: The text names 伊尹; "yiyin day" is a corrupted rendering of the personal name Yi Yin.

proposals.before: Therefore yiyin day toiled at cauldrons and stands, Grand Duke Tai was trapped at drumming the knife, Baili sold himself, Ningzi fed oxen—leaving this misfortune.
proposals.after: Therefore Yi Yin toiled at cauldrons and stands, Grand Duke Tai was trapped at drumming the knife, Baili sold himself, Ningzi fed oxen—leaving this misfortune.
proposals.reason: The text names 伊尹; "yiyin day" is a corrupted rendering of the personal name Yi Yin.

proposals.before: When the realm is at peace and the throne is wise, great men come unbidden, as when Yao, Shun, Yu, Tang, Wen, and Wu won the service of Hou Ji, Xie, Gao Yao, yiyin day, and Lü Wang—radiant ministers ranked in solemn order, pooling their insight until ruler and subject shine the brighter together.
proposals.after: When the realm is at peace and the throne is wise, great men come unbidden, as when Yao, Shun, Yu, Tang, Wen, and Wu won the service of Hou Ji, Xie, Gao Yao, Yi Yin, and Lü Wang—radiant ministers ranked in solemn order, pooling their insight until ruler and subject shine the brighter together.
proposals.reason: The text names 伊尹; "yiyin day" is a corrupted rendering of the personal name Yi Yin.

proposals.before: Therefore when the age is peaceful and the lord is sage, outstanding elders will arrive of themselves; like the lords Yao, Shun, Yu, Tang, Wen, and Wu, obtaining Ji, Xie, Gao Yao, yiyin day, and Lü Wang—bright bright in court, solemn solemn arrayed in rows, gathering essence, meeting spirit, mutually obtaining increased splendor.
proposals.after: Therefore when the age is peaceful and the lord is sage, outstanding elders will arrive of themselves; like the lords Yao, Shun, Yu, Tang, Wen, and Wu, obtaining Ji, Xie, Gao Yao, Yi Yin, and Lü Wang—bright bright in court, solemn solemn arrayed in rows, gathering essence, meeting spirit, mutually obtaining increased splendor.
proposals.reason: The text names 伊尹; "yiyin day" is a corrupted rendering of the personal name Yi Yin.

proposals.before: Critics dismissed such verse as frivolous and beside the point of government, but the emperor replied, 'Confucius himself asked whether a game of chess was not still better than doing nothing at all.
proposals.after: Critics dismissed such verse as frivolous and beside the point of government, but the emperor replied, 'Are there not chess players? To play is still better than doing nothing at all.
proposals.reason: The Chinese quotes 不有博弈者乎 without naming Confucius; the current idiomatic English invents an explicit attribution.

proposals.before: Yet their land south did not pass Min-Yue, north did not pass Taiyuan, yet the realm collapsed and rebelled; disaster finally at the end of the Second Generation; the song of the Great Wall to this day has not ceased.
proposals.after: Yet their land south did not pass Min-Yue, north did not pass Taiyuan, yet the realm collapsed and rebelled; disaster finally came at the end of the Second Emperor; the song of the Great Wall to this day has not ceased.
proposals.reason: 二世 here is the Qin Second Emperor, not a generic "Second Generation."

proposals.before: Xing said: 'The county official once said Xing is superior to Minister Xue—I am easy to help.
proposals.after: Xing said: 'The emperor once said Xing is superior to Minister Xue—I am easy to help.
proposals.reason: In Han usage 縣官 denotes the emperor/throne, not a county official; the idiomatic already renders this correctly.

proposals.before: If you want preferment, brother, follow my advice: humor him for now, and you will win your way in.'
proposals.after: If you want preferment, simply follow my advice: humor him for now, and you will win your way in.'
proposals.reason: Here 弟 is the classical adverbial 'simply/just' (equivalent to 但), not kinship 'brother'.

proposals.before: Now if you wish to advance, younger brother follow my plan; for the moment join his intent, then you will be able to enter.'
proposals.after: Now if you wish to advance, simply follow my plan; for the moment join his intent, then you will be able to enter.'
proposals.reason: Here 弟 is the classical adverbial 'simply/just' (equivalent to 但), not 'younger brother'.

proposals.before: Xing and Jia Juanzhi were therefore sent to prison, and the empress's father, Wang Jin, Marquis of Yangping, was ordered to conduct a joint investigation with Shi Xian. They memorialized: 'Xing and Juanzhi harbored deceit, used the emperor's words to hint to one another, praised and recommended each other in turn, sought high office, leaked words spoken within the palace, and deceived their sovereign in an impious way.
proposals.after: Xing and Jia Juanzhi were therefore sent to prison, and the empress's father, Jin, Marquis of Yangping, was ordered to conduct a joint investigation with Shi Xian. They memorialized: 'Xing and Juanzhi harbored deceit, used the emperor's words to hint to one another, praised and recommended each other in turn, sought high office, leaked words spoken within the palace, and deceived their sovereign in an impious way.
proposals.reason: The Chinese names him only as 禁; the surname Wang is not in the source sentence and should not be invented in the translation.

proposals.before: Thereupon Xing and Juanzhi were sent down to prison; ordered the empress's father, Marquis of Yangping Wang Jin, together with Xian jointly to try mixedly; memorialized: 'Xing and Juanzhi harbor deceit and falsehood, using superior words to signal each other, alternately recommending and praising, wishing to obtain great position, leaking and divulging inner-palace words, deceiving the superior, conduct that is heinous and disloyal.
proposals.after: Thereupon Xing and Juanzhi were sent down to prison; ordered the empress's father, Marquis of Yangping Jin, together with Xian jointly to try mixedly; memorialized: 'Xing and Juanzhi harbor deceit and falsehood, using superior words to signal each other, alternately recommending and praising, wishing to obtain great position, leaking and divulging inner-palace words, deceiving the superior, conduct that is heinous and disloyal.
proposals.reason: The Chinese names him only as 禁; the surname Wang is not in the source sentence and should not be invented in the translation.

decisions.reason: Focus unit has 略薉州, not 珠崖; Zhuya is the wrong place, and Huizhou correctly renders 薉州.

decisions.after: Yi Yin labored over pots and chopping boards; the Grand Duke was reduced to working as a butcher; Baili Xi sold himself, and Ning Qi fed oxen. In this way they escaped their hardships.
decisions.reason: 伊尹 is Yi Yin, while the full revision also renders 鼎俎, 鼓刀, and the four men's emergence from hardship in natural English.

decisions.after: Thus Yi Yin labored at cauldrons and chopping boards, the Grand Duke was reduced to wielding a butcher's knife, Baili Xi sold himself, and Ning Qi fed oxen; thereby they escaped these hardships.
decisions.reason: 伊尹 is Yi Yin; the fuller revision removes the corrupt name and gives each allusion and the concluding clause a grammatical rendering.

decisions.after: Thus, in an age of peace under a sage ruler, outstanding elders come of their own accord. Yao, Shun, Yu, Tang, Kings Wen and Wu obtained the service of Hou Ji, Xie, Gao Yao, Yi Yin, and Lü Wang. Brilliant at court and solemn in their ranks, they joined their finest insights and magnified the glory of ruler and minister alike.
decisions.reason: The source names Yi Yin and describes worthy ministers gathering naturally around sage rulers; the revision restores the name and makes the full comparison readable.

decisions.after: Therefore, when the age is peaceful and the ruler is a sage, outstanding elders arrive of themselves. Yao, Shun, Yu, Tang, Kings Wen and Wu obtained Hou Ji, Xie, Gao Yao, Yi Yin, and Lü Wang. Brilliant at court and solemnly arrayed, they united their finest insight and spirit, bringing greater splendor to ruler and minister alike.
decisions.reason: The literal must restore Yi Yin and preserve the sentence's parallel list, courtly imagery, and conclusion in grammatical English.

decisions.after: Critics dismissed such verse as frivolous and irrelevant, but the emperor replied with a line from the Analects: 'Are there not board games? Playing them is still better than doing nothing.'
decisions.reason: The emperor quotes the Analects without naming Confucius directly; identifying the work preserves useful context while rendering 博弈 as board games rather than chess alone.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 上曰：「『不有博弈者乎，為之猶賢乎已！』

decisions.after: Yet Qin's territory extended no farther south than Minyue and no farther north than Taiyuan, and still the realm disintegrated in revolt. Disaster finally came at the end of the Second Emperor's reign, and songs of the Great Wall have not ceased to this day.
decisions.reason: In this Qin context 二世 is the Second Emperor; the full revision also restores the sentence's subject and contrast rather than changing one phrase inside an ungrammatical draft.

decisions.after: Yang Xing said, 'The emperor once said that I was better than Grandee Xue. It should be easy for you to help me.
decisions.reason: Here 縣官 means the emperor, and 我易助也 means that Yang Xing should be easy for Jia Juanzhi to help; it does not describe Xing as an ally.

decisions.after: If you want to advance, just follow my advice: accommodate Shi Xian for now, and you will gain access to the court.'
decisions.reason: 弟 is the adverb 'just,' not kinship; 合意 means temporarily accommodating Shi Xian's wishes, not merely humoring an unnamed person.

decisions.after: Now, if you wish to advance, just follow my plan: align yourself with Shi Xian for the moment, and you will be able to enter the court.'
decisions.reason: 弟 is the adverb 'just,' not 'younger brother'; the revision makes the implied object Shi Xian and the goal of court access explicit from context.
禁 is Wang Jin, Marquis of Yangping and father of Empress Wang Zhengjun. Supplying his surname is a correct and useful referent expansion, not an invented person.
The literal correctly identifies 禁 as Wang Jin from his title and relationship; deleting the surname would make the reference less clear without improving fidelity.

claimRevisions.reason: 太公 is the title Grand Duke here; the corrected translation removes the redundant English name Tai.
